planets.blurb.moon: Grey, dusty and full of craters. You jump enormously high here.
planets.blurb.mars: Red rock and giant canyons. The sky is orange all day long.
planets.blurb.venus: Yellow, hot and horrible. Water boils away the moment you pour it.
planets.blurb.pluto: Tiny, frozen and a very long way out. Almost no gravity at all.
planets.blurb.overworld: Home. Grass, trees, air you can actually breathe.
planets.screen.title: Where do you want to go?

planets.message.no_rocket: You need to be standing next to a rocket.
